stemMarkdown: 20 litres of a 20% acid solution is mixed with 60 litres of a 50% acid solution. What is the acid concentration (in %) of the resulting mixture? (Round to 2 decimal places.)
solutionMarkdown: Acid from the first: $4.00$ L. From the second: $30.00$ L. Total acid $= 34.00$ L in $80$ L of mixture, so the concentration is $42.5\%$.
